issues.title: Exist filter is reset to default when adding new filter
issues.body:
## 🐞 Bug description
Exist filter is reset to default when adding new filter

## 🔢 Steps to Reproduce
Steps to reproduce the behavior:
1. Play game with data wargame-l6nngxlk
2. Go to 'Core Mapping' channel
3. Add one filter with not default value (example : Force filter is Blue)
4. Add second filter (example : Label filter )
5. Notice the first filter is reset value to  default (Force filter is revert to 'Red')


## ⚙️ Expected behavior
The filter is not changed to default when adding new filter

## 🖥️ Screencast


https://github.com/serge-web/serge/assets/107697044/f64fa441-431d-4f51-b2d2-ec2948d0bbc3
